full_judgment:
Syed J.R. Mudassir Husain CJ: This criminal review petition, at the instance of Mahbubul Goni, the petitioner being on bail, has been directed against the judgment and order dated 02-02-2005 passed by this Division in criminal petition for leave to Appeal No. 92 of 2004 upholding the judgment and order dated 21-03-2004 passed by the High Court Division in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 2250 of 2002 discharging the Rule. 

 3. The accused-petitioner being thus aggrieved moved the High Court Division under Section 561A of the Code of Criminal Procedure. The High Division upon hearing the parties made the Rule absolute by judgment and order dated 25-07-2001 by setting aside the order of the learned Magistrate taking cognizance under Section 420 of the Penal Code and directed the learned Magistrate to proceed in the light of the observations made in the body of the judgment. After receipts of the case records, learned Magistrate took up the matter and he after hearing the parties framed charged against the accused-petitioner under Section 397 of the Act. 

 4. Being aggrieved the accused petitioner filed Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 2250 of 2002 under Section 561A of the Code of Criminal Procedure. The learned Judges or the High Court Division after hearing the parties discharged the Rule. Thereafter, the accused-petitioner filed Criminal petition of leave to Appeal No. 92 of 2004 before this Division and this Division upon hearing the parties dismissed the same on 02-02-2005 holding that the accused-petitioner being the Managing Director of the company was entrusted with the property of the company, who dishonestly misappropriated the company's money or made false statement in arrival return. 

 8. In such view of the matter, we find that the petitioner could not make out the case of review. Hence, we find no ground to review of our judgment. Accordingly, this petition is dismissed.
